title: Treat it with AI: how to treat your condition with AI and a real doctor
summary: AI treatment by condition: how your AI takes your history and a FutureClinic doctor treats you by message for $40 a visit, plus 31 condition guides.
body_markdown:
Treating a health condition with AI on FutureClinic starts in the AI app you already use: your AI helps gather your medical history, and a licensed physician reviews your case and treats you by message for $40 a visit, with no subscription required. FutureClinic connects you with over 300 doctors. Generalists and specialists practice across more than 60 specialties. FutureClinic is not for emergencies: call 911 in a medical emergency, or call or text 988 in a mental-health crisis.


We believe AI is a tool for doctors, and the human doctor belongs in charge of every case. Most health problems have nuance and need one-to-one attention, and only an expert knows when an AI has made a mistake or is heading toward the wrong answer. On FutureClinic, the AI works behind the scenes like a chief resident: it gathers your history and prepares the case so the doctor moves faster, and it never gives medical advice by itself. Every doctor is a state-licensed, background-checked and verified physician with an MD, DO or MBBS degree, never a nurse practitioner or physician assistant. No form is approved in bulk: a specific doctor reads your whole case and answers with a Human Signature, a live recorded video or voice note.


Before choosing an online care service, it helps to ask yourself a simple question: do you want a single-condition subscription brand and its monthly requirements, or do you just want a doctor of your own? If you want a company's specific compounded formula or medicines bundled into a recurring plan, those brands are built for that, whereas FutureClinic gives you an expert physician with no ongoing commitment.


## How your AI and physician work together


Start from the AI app you already use or on futureclinic.com. Your AI helps answer intake questions from what you already told it, and you confirm a summary before your doctor sees it. You can also share medical records, photos or video. Replies typically arrive within a few hours, almost always the same day or the next, because real care takes hours rather than seconds.


You stay with the same doctor in the same chat to adjust a dose, swap an irritating cream, or compare lab results over time. Your doctor can help with other problems in their specialty, such as a dermatologist treating hair loss who also treats your acne or eczema, and every FutureClinic doctor you see works from one medical record. Doctors earn nothing extra for any prescription or test. If your doctor decides it's right for you, they can prescribe several months of a stable medicine when safe, help with prior authorizations, and send prescriptions to the pharmacy you choose, including mail-order delivery, where insurance or a discount coupon can apply.
